list.empty: No tasks in this project yet
list.unavailable: This project's tasks folder cannot be read
list.newPlaceholder: Add a task and press Enter
list.notEditable: This ticket's format is non-standard and can't be edited here. Open it in an external editor.
list.confirmDelete: Delete this task? The file is removed and cannot be restored.
list.conflict: This task was changed elsewhere. Reloading.
list.actionError: That did not work. Try again.
list.draftStale: You have an unsaved draft, but this ticket was changed after you left. The draft is based on the old version; saving after restoring it will be rejected.
list.draftUnsavable: The draft can't be saved (browser storage may be full or disabled). If this save fails, there's no fallback. Continue?
list.draftUnsavableSave: The draft can't be saved (browser storage may be full or disabled), so this save was not sent. Copy your content, or try Save again once storage is available.
list.conflictEditor: This ticket was changed elsewhere. Your content was NOT saved. The file is untouched and your text is still below.
list.saveFailedNotEditable: This ticket can no longer be edited here — something outside the app changed its format while you had it open. Your content was not saved; copy it and use an external editor.
list.saveFailedInvalidContent: This ticket's title or body isn't in a form that can be saved. Your content was not saved — copy it, remove any unusual characters, and try again.
list.saveFailedWriteFailed: The file couldn't be written — this looks like a disk or filesystem problem, not something you did. Your content is safe in the draft; try again once it clears.
list.saveFailedGeneric: Save failed. Your content is safe in the draft — try again.
list.orphanDraft: This ticket is gone, but you have an unsaved draft: {{title}}
list.orphanUnavailable: This project's tasks can't be read right now. The draft is kept.
